name: condition
description: Task-condition selector (1=exercise/staircase, 2=main estimation, 3=demo). Set at startup from expInfo and held constant across blocks. Evidence: par.condition assignments at lines 166/176/181 with task-dependent values.

name: StairTrainTest
description: Block-kind selector — indexes par.nT to pick trial count per block. par.StairTrainTest is set per block (often = 2*ones for main flow, vector for exercise). Used as par.nT(par.StairTrainTest).

name: tvm1
description: Per-trial duration of the first visible motion segment, sampled before the occluded interval. Stored at par.trial.tvm1{iR}(iT).

name: tvm2
description: Per-trial duration of the second visible motion segment.

name: tvm3
description: Per-trial duration of the third visible motion segment.

name: occ_deg
description: Per-trial occlusion arc length in degrees. par.trial.occ_deg{iR}(iT).

name: dir1
description: Direction sign of the first motion segment. par.trial.dir1{iR}(iT).

name: dir2
description: Direction sign of the second motion segment. par.trial.dir2{iR}(iT).

name: start1
description: Starting angle of the first visible motion segment. par.trial.start1{iR}(iT).

name: start2
description: Starting angle of the second visible motion segment. par.trial.start2{iR}(iT).

name: speed1
description: Angular speed of the first motion segment. par.trial.speed1{iR}(iT).

name: speed2
description: Angular speed of the second motion segment. par.trial.speed2{iR}(iT).

name: tstim
description: Stimulus epoch duration (par.tstim = 3 in param_TrialRunTime_Duration).

name: tmask
description: Mask epoch duration (par.tmask = 0.5).

name: trespcue
description: Response-cue duration (par.trespcue = 0.5).

name: tdelay
description: Delay duration (par.tdelay = 0.5).

name: tresponse
description: Per-block response window (length-3 array; selected by par.condition / par.StairTrainTest).

name: titi
description: Per-block inter-trial interval (length-3 array).

name: nR
description: Number of blocks — derived from length(par.condition).

name: ttotal
description: Estimated total run duration in minutes; computed from per-epoch timings.

name: dist
description: Stimulus-distribution code (1=Uniform, 2=Left-skewed, 3=Right-skewed). Per-session input from expInfo.

name: subjNum
description: Participant number, supplied at startup.

name: day
description: Day index (1..N) for longitudinal sessions.

name: isexercise
description: 1=staircase/exercise run, 0=main run.

name: isdemo
description: 1=demo/walkthrough, 0=real run.

name: expType
description: Experiment type code; sub-directory results/timeExp{expType}.

name: screenNumber
description: PTB screen index (par.screenNumber).

name: backgroundlum
description: Background luminance, normalised [0,1] (par.backgroundlum = 0.03).

name: ringrad
description: Ring stimulus radius in degrees of visual angle.

name: ringwidth
description: Ring stimulus thickness in degrees of visual angle.

name: results.mat
description: Final-state save — entire par struct dumped at experiment end. save(fullfile(par.savedir,'results.mat'),'finalState').

name: codebackup.zip
description: Source-code snapshot zipped at run start (sub/* + active script).

name: run-wise-backup/results_iR.mat
description: Per-block intermediate state save under savedir/run-wise-backup/.

name: logSlope
description: Per-block log-log regression slope on stimulus vs reproduction.

name: logR2
description: Per-block log-log regression R².

name: varWithinStimRepro
description: Per-block within-stimulus reproduction variance.

name: sdErrRepro
description: Per-block reproduction-error standard deviation.
